sections.advice: St Moritz → Pontresina is 6 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

Bernina Pass → Poschiavo drops about 2330 m over 12 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Poschiavo → Tirano is 19 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 11 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2330 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

bernina-pass-road.story: 95 km one way from St. Moritz - plan on about 1 h 39 of riding. On the way it passes Pontresina, Bernina Pass and Poschiavo. The highest point is about 2,500 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
